_note: THE FOUR BIG NUMBERS — the band that appears on the home, About, Services
`value` must be a plain number (no commas) because it counts up as the
band scrolls into view. Put any symbol in `suffix` instead — %, +, k, and
so on. Leave `suffix` as "" for none.
These numbers are quoted in sentences elsewhere on the site using
{{stats.items.2.value}} and the like, so editing one here keeps the prose
honest. Counting starts at the first entry: items.0 is Products shipped.
